page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 23.0 GB of system memory. The instance is equipped with a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU, providing 4 GB of dedicated VRAM representing a 0.25x GPU allocation. It does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates modest performance characteristics. Its CPU capabilities are positioned in the lower tier, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1103.98 and a multi-core score of 2934.21, both falling into the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory performance is similarly constrained; read-only large block bandwidth is measured at 19.82 GB/sec, and the Passmark memory score is 1394.68, reflecting lower-tier memory throughput. Cryptographic and vector processing are supported via AVX, AVX512F, and AES instruction sets.

The inclusion of a fractional GPU offers a cost-effective entry point for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the expense of a dedicated full GPU. However, the trade-off is reflected in lower overall processing and memory speeds, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 904.0 and multi-core score of 2011.0. This resource profile is best suited for entry-level GPU-accelerated applications, virtual workstations, lightweight machine learning inference, and development environments that require CUDA support but do not demand high-throughput CPU or memory performance.
